scientific_motivation.new_hypothesis: BEST_INSERT versus the strongest permitted non-addition explanation in the same exact CTC likelihood space
scientific_motivation.intended_mechanism: Reduce false addition explanations when substitution or deletion makes KEEP acoustically weak.

reuse_boundary.r3: Reuse only the canonical substitution concept; no R3 model output, probability, margin, or threshold.
reuse_boundary.r4: Reuse deterministic KEEP/SUB/DELETE construction and TARGET-score provenance, not the closed R4 scientific conclusion.
reuse_boundary.r5_1a: Reuse alignability-safe score semantics, BEST_INSERT tie behavior, extended-real handling, threshold helper, and cohort/population definitions without modifying the frozen scorer.
